 199      assert request.recipe.query_count == 4096
 200      sampled_request = replace(request, recipe=replace(request.recipe, query_count=2048))
 201      sample = dataset[sampled_request]
 202      original = sample["queries"]
 203      anchor = {key: value.copy() for key, value in original.items()}
 204      ids = original["point_id"]
 205      assert len(ids) == 2048 and original["is_dynamic"].sum() == 1536
 206      times = np.asarray(sample["timestamps"], dtype=np.float32)
 207      source_frame = np.empty(len(ids), dtype=np.int64)
 208      for source, name in enumerate(request.camera_names):
 209          selected = original["v_src"] == source
 210          camera_times = np.asarray(sample["view_timestamps"][name], dtype=np.float32)
 211          frame = abs(original["t_src"][selected, None] - camera_times[None]).argmin(1)
 212          np.testing.assert_array_equal(camera_times[frame], original["t_src"][selected])
 213          # This experiment deliberately uses synchronized simulator cameras.
 214          np.testing.assert_array_equal(times[frame], original["t_src"][selected])
 215          assert sample["point_visible"][name][frame, ids[selected]].all()
 216          source_frame[selected] = frame
 217      assert sample["point_valid"][source_frame, ids].all()
 218      anchor["t_tgt"] = times[source_frame]
 219      for output, name in enumerate(request.camera_names):
 220          selected = original["v_cam"] == output
 221          camera_times = np.asarray(sample["view_timestamps"][name], dtype=np.float32)
 222          pose_frame = abs(original["t_cam"][selected, None] - camera_times[None]).argmin(
 223              1
 224          )
 225          np.testing.assert_array_equal(
 226              camera_times[pose_frame], original["t_cam"][selected]
 227          )
 228          poses = sample["T_wc"][name]
 229          pose = poses[pose_frame].astype(np.float64)
 230          world = sample["point_world"][source_frame[selected], ids[selected]].astype(
 231              np.float64
 232          )
 233          xyz = np.linalg.solve(pose[:, :3, :3], (world - pose[:, :3, 3])[..., None])[
 234              ..., 0
 235          ]
 236          anchor["target_xyz_cam"][selected] = xyz.astype(np.float32)
 237          k = sample["K"][name]
 238          if k.ndim == 3:
 239              k = k[pose_frame]
 240          h = np.einsum("...ij,...j->...i", k.astype(np.float64), xyz)
 241          uv = h[:, :2] / np.maximum(h[:, 2:], 1e-8)
 242          height, width = request.image_shapes[output]
 243          inside = (
 244              (xyz[:, 2] > 1e-6)
 245              & np.isfinite(uv).all(1)
 246              & (uv >= 0).all(1)
 247              & (uv[:, 0] <= width - 1)
 248              & (uv[:, 1] <= height - 1)
 249          )
 250          anchor["visibility"][selected] = (
 251              sample["point_visible"][name][source_frame[selected], ids[selected]]
 252              & inside
 253          )
 254      anchor["is_hard"] = anchor["is_dynamic"] | ~anchor["visibility"]
 255      sample["queries"] = {
 256          key: np.concatenate([original[key], anchor[key]]) for key in original
 257      }

  70              # Keep the prediction's scale differentiable, including occlusions.
  71              xyz = xyz.float()
  72              depth = xyz[:, 2].abs()
  73              sums = depth.new_zeros(sample_count).index_add(0, sample_indices, depth)
  74              counts = depth.new_zeros(sample_count).index_add(
  75                  0, sample_indices, torch.ones_like(depth)
  76              )
  77              mean_depth = (sums / counts.clamp_min(1)).clamp_min(1e-6)
  78              normalized = xyz / mean_depth[sample_indices, None]
  79              # Signed log has derivative 1 at zero. sign(x) * log1p(abs(x))
  80              # incorrectly gives zero there through PyTorch's sign/abs rules.
  81              positive = normalized >= 0
  82              magnitude = torch.where(positive, normalized, -normalized).log1p()
  83              return torch.where(positive, magnitude, -magnitude)
  84  
  85          error = (preprocess(output.mean) - preprocess(target_xyz_cam)).abs().mean(-1)
  86          confidence = output.confidence_logits.float().sigmoid().clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
  87          geometry = confidence * error - 0.2 * confidence.log()
  88      else:
  89          geometry_error = functional.smooth_l1_loss(
  90              output.mean.float(),
  91              target_xyz_cam.float(),
  92              beta=huber_beta,
  93              reduction="none",
  94          ).mean(dim=-1)
  95          geometry = geometry_error / scale + scale.log()
  96      visibility = functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
  97          output.visibility.float(),
  98          target_visibility.float(),
  99          reduction="none",
 100      )
 101      local_sum = geometry.sum() + visibility_weight * visibility.sum()
 102      return ObjectiveTerms(
 103          local_sum=local_sum,
 104          local_count=count,
 105          metrics={
 106              "queries": count,
 107              "visible_queries": visible.sum().detach(),
 108              "geometry_sum": geometry.detach().sum(),
 109              "visibility_sum": visibility.detach().sum(),
 110          },

56  def build_multiview_track_queries(
  57      sample,
  58      request,
  59      *,
  60      point_ids,
  61      source_camera,
  62  ):
  63      """Build fixed-t0 tracks with one query per time, point, and target view."""
  64      from train.data.queries import _inside_image, _query_context, _selected_uv
  65  
  66      cameras = tuple(request.camera_names)
  67      if cameras != AGENT_CAMERAS or source_camera not in cameras:
  68          raise ValueError("evaluation requires the canonical three agent cameras")
  69      context = _query_context(sample, request)
  70      point_ids = np.asarray(point_ids, dtype=np.int64)
  71      if point_ids.ndim != 1 or not len(point_ids) or len(np.unique(point_ids)) != len(
  72          point_ids
  73      ):
  74          raise ValueError("point_ids must be a nonempty unique vector")
  75      frames, views, points = context["frames"], len(cameras), len(point_ids)
  76      if not context["valid"][:, point_ids].all() or not context["camera_valid"].all():
  77          raise ValueError("frozen tracks require valid points and cameras throughout")
  78  
  79      source_view = cameras.index(source_camera)
  80      height, width = context["image_shapes"][source_view]
  81      source_uv = np.stack(
  82          [
  83              _selected_uv(sample, context, source_view, 0, int(point_id))
  84              for point_id in point_ids
  85          ]
  86      )
  87      if not all(_inside_image(uv, (height, width)) for uv in source_uv):
  88          raise ValueError("a frozen point lacks source-camera t0 evidence")
  89      source_uv = source_uv / [max(width - 1, 1), max(height - 1, 1)]
  90  
  91      world = np.asarray(sample["point_world"])[:, point_ids]
  92      camera_from_world = context["camera_from_world"]
  93      target_xyz = np.einsum(
  94          "vtij,tpj->tpvi", camera_from_world[:, :, :3, :3], world
  95      )
  96      target_xyz += camera_from_world[:, :, None, :3, 3].transpose(1, 2, 0, 3)
  97      projected = np.einsum("vtij,tpvj->tpvi", context["intrinsics"], target_xyz)
  98      target_uv = projected[..., :2] / projected[..., 2:]
  99      shapes = np.asarray(context["image_shapes"])
 100      inside = np.isfinite(target_uv).all(-1) & (target_xyz[..., 2] > 0)
 101      inside &= (
 102          (target_uv[..., 0] >= 0)
 103          & (target_uv[..., 0] <= shapes[None, None, :, 1] - 1)
 104          & (target_uv[..., 1] >= 0)
 105          & (target_uv[..., 1] <= shapes[None, None, :, 0] - 1)
 106      )
 107      visible = context["visible"][:, :, point_ids].transpose(1, 2, 0) & inside
 108  
 109      timestamps = np.asarray(sample["timestamps"], dtype=np.float32)
 110      view_timestamps = np.stack(
 111          [
 112              np.asarray(sample.get("view_timestamps", {}).get(name, timestamps))
 113              for name in cameras
 114          ],
 115          axis=1,
 116      ).astype(np.float32)
 117      shape = (frames, points, views)
 118      dynamic = np.broadcast_to(context["dynamic"][point_ids][None, :, None], shape)
 119      return {
 120          "uv": np.broadcast_to(source_uv[None, :, None, :], (*shape, 2))
 121          .reshape(-1, 2)
 122          .astype(np.float32),
 123          "t_src": np.full(np.prod(shape), view_timestamps[0, source_view], np.float32),
 124          "v_src": np.full(np.prod(shape), source_view, np.int64),
 125          "t_tgt": np.broadcast_to(timestamps[:, None, None], shape)
 126          .reshape(-1)
 127          .astype(np.float32),
 128          "t_cam": np.broadcast_to(view_timestamps[:, None, :], shape)
 129          .reshape(-1)
 130          .astype(np.float32),
 131          "v_cam": np.broadcast_to(np.arange(views)[None, None, :], shape)
 132          .reshape(-1)
 133          .astype(np.int64),
 134          "target_xyz_cam": target_xyz.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32),
 135          "visibility": visible.reshape(-1),
 136          "point_id": np.broadcast_to(point_ids[None, :, None], shape).reshape(-1),
 137          "is_dynamic": dynamic.reshape(-1),
 138          "is_hard": (dynamic | ~visible).reshape(-1),
 139      }
 140

234  def _score(
 235      raw,
 236      target,
 237      visible,
 238      poses,
 239      intrinsics,
 240      scale,
 241      center,
 242      world_gt,
 243      source_camera,
 244  ):
 245      alpha = float(
 246          np.abs(target[..., 2]).mean() / max(np.abs(raw[..., 2]).mean(), 1e-6)
 247      )
 248      aligned_world = camera_to_world_by_view(raw * alpha, poses, scale, center)
 249      reconstructed_gt = camera_to_world_by_view(target, poses, scale, center)
 250      np.testing.assert_allclose(
 251          reconstructed_gt,
 252          np.broadcast_to(world_gt[:, :, None, :], reconstructed_gt.shape),
 253          rtol=2e-5,
 254          atol=2e-5,
 255      )
 256      pred_uv = project_camera_tracks(raw, intrinsics)
 257      gt_uv = project_camera_tracks(target, intrinsics)
 258      rows = []
 259      for view, camera in enumerate(AGENT_CAMERAS):
 260          good = visible[:, :, view] & np.isfinite(pred_uv[:, :, view]).all(-1)
 261          pixel = np.linalg.norm(
 262              pred_uv[:, :, view] - gt_uv[:, :, view], axis=-1
 263          )[good]
 264          xyz = np.linalg.norm(
 265              aligned_world[..., view, :] - world_gt, axis=-1
 266          ).reshape(-1)
 267          rows.append(
 268              {
 269                  "source_camera": source_camera,
 270                  "target_camera": camera,
 271                  "query_case": "same_view" if camera == source_camera else "cross_view",
 272                  "pixel_count": int(len(pixel)),
 273                  "pixel_epe_sum": float(pixel.sum(dtype=np.float64)),
 274                  "pixel_epe_mean": float(pixel.mean()) if len(pixel) else None,
 275                  "aligned_xyz_count": int(len(xyz)),
 276                  "aligned_xyz_epe_sum": float(xyz.sum(dtype=np.float64)),
 277                  "aligned_xyz_epe_mean": float(xyz.mean()),
 278              }
 279          )
 280      pairwise = np.concatenate(
 281          [
 282              np.linalg.norm(aligned_world[..., a, :] - aligned_world[..., b, :], axis=-1).reshape(-1)
 283              for a, b in combinations(range(3), 2)
 284          ]
 285      )
 286      return alpha, aligned_world, pred_uv, gt_uv, rows, {
 287          "count": int(len(pairwise)),
 288          "sum": float(pairwise.sum(dtype=np.float64)),
 289          "mean": float(pairwise.mean()),
 290      }

131      return 0

 134  def metrics(metadata, prediction, visibility):
 135      q = metadata["queries"]
 136      n, g = metadata["main_count"], metadata["source_count"]
 137      gt = q["target_xyz_cam"].astype(np.float64)
 138      pred = prediction.astype(np.float64)
 139      if not np.isfinite(pred).all() or not np.isfinite(visibility).all():
 140          raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite evaluation outputs")
 141      cal = slice(n + g, len(pred))
 142      gt_norm, pred_norm = np.linalg.norm(gt[cal], axis=1), np.linalg.norm(pred[cal], axis=1)
 143      if min(pred_norm) <= 1e-12:
 144          raise ValueError("degenerate CAL prediction")
 145      alpha = float(np.median(gt_norm / pred_norm))
 146      legacy = float(np.median(gt_norm) / np.median(pred_norm))
 147      depth = float(np.abs(gt[cal, 2]).mean())
 148      if depth <= 1e-12:
 149          raise ValueError("degenerate CAL depth")
 150      error = np.linalg.norm(pred[:n] * alpha - gt[:n], axis=1) / depth
 151      old_error = np.linalg.norm(pred[:n] * legacy - gt[:n], axis=1) / depth
 152      zerror = np.abs(pred[:n, 2] * alpha - gt[:n, 2]) / depth
 153      groups = []
 154      for dynamic in (True, False):
 155          for src in range(3):
 156              for cam in range(3):
 157                  keep = ((q["is_dynamic"][:n] == dynamic) &
 158                          (q["v_src"][:n] == src) & (q["v_cam"][:n] == cam))
 159                  if not keep.any():
 160                      continue  # explicitly reported missing GT support, common to all arms
 161                  groups.append(dict(dynamic=dynamic, source_view=src, camera_view=cam,
 162                                     xyz=float(error[keep].mean()),
 163                                     depth=float(zerror[keep].mean()),
 164                                     legacy_xyz=float(old_error[keep].mean())))
 165      source = np.arange(n, n + g)
 166      K = metadata["K"][q["v_cam"][source], metadata["camera_frame"][source]]
 167      projected = np.einsum("nij,nj->ni", K, pred[source])
 168      valid = (pred[source, 2] > 1e-6) & np.isfinite(projected).all(1)
 169      pixel = q["uv"][source] * (metadata["image_shapes"][q["v_src"][source], ::-1] - 1)
 170      # A finite large penalty records invalid projections; never drops those rows.
 171      pixel_error = np.full(g, 1e6)
 172      pixel_error[valid] = np.linalg.norm(
 173          projected[valid, :2] / projected[valid, 2:] - pixel[valid], axis=1)
 174      motion = []
 175      for src in range(3):
 176          for cam in range(3):
 177              mask = q["is_dynamic"][:n] & (q["v_src"][:n] == src) & (q["v_cam"][:n] == cam)
 178              for point in np.unique(q["point_id"][:n][mask]):
 179                  keep = np.flatnonzero(mask & (q["point_id"][:n] == point))
 180                  p, t = pred[keep] * alpha, gt[keep]
 181                  motion.append(float(np.linalg.norm(
 182                      (p - p.mean(0)) - (t - t.mean(0)), axis=1).mean() / depth))
 183      return dict(
 184          family=metadata["row"]["family"], group_id=metadata["row"]["group_id"],
 185          sample_id=metadata["row"]["sample_id"], alpha=alpha, legacy_alpha=legacy,
 186          dynamic_xyz=float(np.mean([x["xyz"] for x in groups if x["dynamic"]])),
 187          static_xyz=float(np.mean([x["xyz"] for x in groups if not x["dynamic"]])),
 188          dynamic_depth=float(np.mean([x["depth"] for x in groups if x["dynamic"]])),
 189          legacy_dynamic_xyz=float(np.mean([x["legacy_xyz"] for x in groups if x["dynamic"]])),
 190          source_pixel_mean=float(pixel_error.mean()),
 191          source_pixel_p90=float(np.quantile(pixel_error, .9)),
 192          source_depth=float(np.abs(pred[source, 2] * alpha - gt[source, 2]).mean() / depth),
 193          motion=float(np.mean(motion)),
 194          invalid_source_fraction=float((~valid).mean()),
 195          visibility_accuracy=float(((visibility[:n] >= 0) == q["visibility"][:n]).mean()),
 196          groups=groups, skipped_gt_groups=metadata["skipped"])

 199  def summarize(rows):
 200      keys = ("dynamic_xyz", "static_xyz", "dynamic_depth", "legacy_dynamic_xyz",
 201              "source_pixel_mean", "source_pixel_p90", "source_depth", "motion",
 202              "invalid_source_fraction", "visibility_accuracy")
 203      grouped = defaultdict(list)
 204      for row in rows:
 205          grouped[(row["family"], row["group_id"])].append(row)
 206      groups = [dict(family=family, group_id=group,
 207                     **{key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in values])) for key in keys})
 208                for (family, group), values in sorted(grouped.items())]
 209      families = {family: {key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in groups if r["family"] == family]))
